sections.title: Day 14 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天不大量加入新文法，而是整合 Day 8～13：**分詞、關係代名詞、where/when、連接詞 vs. 介系詞、時間/條件副詞子句、比較級與最高級**。

目前沒有收到前幾日實際作答成績，因此今天以 **860～900 分程度**進行第二週能力檢測。建議約 **100 分鐘**，今天請特別記錄「正確率 + 花費時間」，因為從第三週開始會逐步接近正式 TOEIC 的解題速度。

sections.title: ② 第二週文法總整理
sections.markdown:
這週其實可以濃縮成六個判斷。

### 分詞

> The customers were **satisfied**.

感受到 → V-ed。

> The results were **encouraging**.

造成感受 → V-ing。

> damaged equipment

設備「被損壞」→ V-ed。

---

### 關係代名詞

> The employee **who** works here...

子句缺主詞。

> The employee **whom** we hired...

子句缺受詞。

> The employee **whose** office...

所有格。

---

### where / when

> The hotel **where** we stayed...

`we stayed` 已完整。

> The hotel **which** we booked...

`we booked _____` 缺受詞。

因此不要只背：

> 地點 = where

真正要看：

> **後面的子句完整嗎？**

---

### 連接詞 vs. 介系詞

> because + S + V  
> because of + N

> although + S + V  
> despite + N

> while + S + V  
> during + N

---

### 未來時間／條件副詞子句

> I'll call you when I **arrive**.

不是：

> when I will arrive ❌

同樣：

> before / after / until / once / if / unless

描述未來時，副詞子句通常使用現在式。

---

### 比較

> much **larger than**

> significantly **higher than**

> the **most profitable**

> as **efficient** as

> twice as **large** as

這六組就是今天週測的核心。

---

sections.title: ③ Listening｜Part 2 第二週週測
sections.markdown:
請每題只讀／聽一次。

### Q1

> When will the replacement equipment arrive?

(A) The supplier hasn't confirmed the shipping date.  
(B) In the storage room.  
(C) About three machines.

### Q2

> Who approved the advertising campaign?

(A) I believe the marketing director did.  
(B) It starts next Monday.  
(C) Approximately $20,000.

### Q3

> Should we choose the less expensive supplier?

(A) How reliable are their deliveries?  
(B) About five hundred units.  
(C) At the distribution center.

### Q4

> Why hasn't the invoice been processed?

(A) Accounting is still reviewing it.  
(B) Approximately $750.  
(C) Last Wednesday.

### Q5

> Haven't you reserved a room for the conference?

(A) I'm waiting for the hotel discount code.  
(B) For three nights.  
(C) Near the convention center.

### Q6

> Which branch generated the most revenue?

(A) The Taipei branch performed best.  
(B) About two million dollars.  
(C) Last quarter.

### Q7

> Didn't the shipment arrive yesterday?

(A) Bad weather delayed the truck.  
(B) At the loading dock.  
(C) Nearly one hundred boxes.

### Q8

> Who's inspecting the damaged products?

(A) Someone from quality control.  
(B) Tomorrow afternoon.  
(C) About thirty units.

### Q9

> Why don't we increase production?

(A) We already have plenty in stock.  
(B) At the Taoyuan factory.  
(C) Approximately ten percent.

### Q10

> Has productivity improved?

(A) By almost twelve percent.  
(B) Three new machines.  
(C) Since last November.

**答案：1A / 2A / 3A / 4A / 5A / 6A / 7A / 8A / 9A / 10A**

Q10 特別重要。

> Has productivity improved?

回答：

> By almost twelve percent.

沒有 Yes。

但「提高約 12%」已經完整回答。

Part 2 高分階段必須習慣這種回答。

sections.title: ④ Reading｜Part 7 第二週週測
sections.markdown:
限時 **4 分鐘**。

> **To:** All Regional Sales Managers  
> **From:** Marketing Director  
> **Subject:** October Promotional Campaign
>
> Following the strong performance of our summer promotion, the company will launch a new advertising campaign on October 5. The campaign will focus primarily on our online store, where sales have increased by more than 25 percent during the past six months.
>
> Customers who spend at least $100 in a single online transaction will receive complimentary shipping. In addition, customers whose purchases exceed $200 will receive a 15 percent discount on selected accessories.
>
> Although the campaign officially begins on October 5, promotional materials will be distributed to regional offices approximately one week earlier. Managers should display these materials as soon as they arrive.
>
> A revised product brochure is currently being prepared. Once the final version is approved, an electronic copy will be sent to all sales representatives.
>
> Last year's October campaign generated significantly more online orders than the company's newspaper advertisements. For this reason, this year's advertising budget has been shifted toward digital channels.
>
> Managers who have questions about the campaign should contact Marketing Coordinator Daniel Wu.

### Q1

Why is the company launching another campaign?

(A) The summer promotion performed well  
(B) Product prices have increased  
(C) A competitor opened a new store  
(D) Newspaper advertising was canceled

### Q2

What has happened to online sales?

(A) They decreased by 25 percent  
(B) They increased by more than 25 percent  
(C) They remained unchanged  
(D) They doubled

### Q3

Who receives free shipping?

(A) Every online customer  
(B) Customers spending at least $100  
(C) Customers spending more than $200 only  
(D) Regional managers

### Q4

When will promotional materials reach regional offices?

(A) Around one week before October 5  
(B) On October 5  
(C) One week after October 5  
(D) After the campaign ends

### Q5

What will happen once the brochure is approved?

(A) Prices will change  
(B) Printed copies will be mailed to customers  
(C) An electronic copy will be sent to sales representatives  
(D) The campaign will end

### Q6

Why has more money been allocated to digital advertising?

(A) Digital advertisements are cheaper  
(B) Online advertising produced better results  
(C) Customers requested fewer advertisements  
(D) Newspaper prices increased

### Q7

The word **“shifted”** is closest in meaning to:

(A) reduced completely  
(B) moved  
(C) calculated  
(D) delayed

**答案：1A / 2B / 3B / 4A / 5C / 6B / 7B**

Q6 是典型推論＋同義改寫。

文章：

> generated significantly more online orders

題目：

> produced better results

正式 TOEIC 很常這樣改寫。

sections.title: ⑦ 第二週成績判定
sections.markdown:

> **20/20，但花 12 分鐘**

sections.title: ⑧ 錯題分類
sections.markdown:
今天開始固定使用五種錯題標籤：

**V — Vocabulary**：不知道單字。

**G — Grammar**：規則判斷錯誤。

**L — Listening**：沒有聽懂。

**P — Paraphrase**：同義改寫沒認出。

**T — Time**：知道答案，但時間不足。

例如：

> Q4 錯 → G → `where` 後面完整句。

> Q17 錯 → L → 期待 Yes/No，沒有接受反問型回答。

> Reading Q6 錯 → P → `generated more orders` 沒連結到 `better results`。

第三週開始，這個分類會比單純記答案更重要。

---

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天不要增加更多新文法。

先重新做「Day 14 正式週測」所有錯題，每題必須說出：

> **為什麼正解對？另外三個為什麼錯？**

接著複習今天 30 組核心搭配。

最後把今天週測重新做一次。

第二次限制：

**5 分鐘。**

目標：

**20/20。**

如果第一次就已經達到 **19～20/20 + 6 分鐘內**，第三週不再花太多時間做單一文法題，會正式提高到 **900+ 訓練模式**：Part 5 混合題比例增加、Part 7 篇幅拉長、同義改寫與推論題增加，而且開始逐步加入 Part 3/4 的短對話與簡短獨白。

今天是第二個重要檢查點。前兩週真正要帶走的不是十幾條文法規則，而是一套固定解題流程：

> **先看結構 → 判斷缺什麼 → 找時間／連接關係 → 判斷詞性與語態 → 最後才確認語意。**

**Day 15** 將正式進入第三週，主題為 **Part 3 對話入門 + 代名詞／指示詞與指涉判斷**，開始把訓練重心從「單句正確」逐步轉向「連續聽力與閱讀資訊定位」。

questions.explanation: employees 是感受者，使用 surprised。

questions.prompt: The _____ sales figures exceeded management's expectations.
questions.explanation: sales figures 令人鼓舞，使用 encouraging。

questions.prompt: Customers _____ orders exceed $300 qualify for free delivery.
questions.explanation: whose 表示 customers 與 orders 的所有關係。

questions.prompt: The office _____ Mr. Lin works is located downtown.
questions.explanation: Mr. Lin works 是完整子句，使用 where。

questions.prompt: The office _____ the company rented has been renovated.
questions.explanation: the company rented 後缺受詞，使用 which。

questions.prompt: Production stopped _____ a mechanical problem.
questions.explanation: a mechanical problem 是名詞片語，使用 because of。

questions.prompt: _____ the machine was repaired, production remained behind schedule.
questions.explanation: the machine was repaired 是完整句，讓步使用 Although。

questions.prompt: Visitors must wear identification badges _____ the factory tour.
questions.explanation: the factory tour 是名詞片語，使用 during。

questions.prompt: We will send the invoice once the order _____.
questions.explanation: once 子句描述未來，使用現在式 ships。

questions.prompt: The store will remain closed until repairs _____.
questions.explanation: repairs 被完成，且 until 子句不用 will，使用 are completed。

questions.prompt: If sales _____ next quarter, additional staff will be hired.
questions.explanation: if 條件子句使用現在式 increase。

questions.prompt: The order will be canceled unless payment _____ today.
questions.explanation: payment 被收到，且 unless 子句不用 will，使用 is received。

questions.prompt: The new system is much _____ than the previous one.
questions.explanation: much 與 than 提示比較級 more efficient。

questions.prompt: This was the _____ successful campaign in company history.
questions.explanation: the most successful 是最高級。

questions.prompt: Our new office is twice as _____ as the previous location.
questions.explanation: twice as + 原級 + as，使用 large。

questions.prompt: When will the replacement parts arrive?

options.A: The supplier hasn't confirmed the date.

questions.explanation: 供應商尚未確認日期，是合理的間接回答。

questions.prompt: Should we select the cheaper supplier?

options.A: How reliable is their delivery service?

questions.explanation: 選擇便宜供應商前詢問交貨可靠性。

questions.prompt: Has productivity improved?
questions.explanation: 提高約 15% 表示生產力確實改善。

questions.prompt: Why hasn't the invoice been paid?
questions.explanation: Accounting is still reviewing it 說明未付款原因。

questions.prompt: Who handles quality inspections?
questions.explanation: Someone from the production team 回答負責者。

keyTakeaway: 先看結構 → 判斷缺什麼 → 找時間／連接關係 → 判斷詞性與語態 → 最後確認語意。
